title: Kunshin da aka gwada, ingantaccen kasafin kuɗi da shirin kwanaki 90
course_title: Horon-na-Masu Horarwa (ToT): Koyar da Manya da Gina Masu Koyarwa

say: Kunshin da aka gwada, ingantaccen kasafin kuɗi, da shirin kwanaki 90.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don tsari na huɗu na kwas ɗin Horon-na-Masu horo.
Mai horon da ya ba da cikakkiyar fakitin da aka gwada wanda wasu ke bayarwa da kyau ya ma fi wanda ke gudanar da zama mai kyau daraja.
Zuciyarta ita ce jagorar mai horarwa, tare da tsare-tsaren zama, lokaci, da mahimman saƙon da ke da alama ko sassauƙa.

Albarkatun ayyuka: katunan wasan kwaikwayo, labarun shari'a
Kayan aikin kimantawa: siffofi, gwaje-gwaje, jerin abubuwan dubawa

say: Ga misalin aiki. Wata kungiyar hadin gwiwa a Abeokuta ta bukaci Kemi da ta horar da mambobi 25 na kwana daya. Wurin kyauta ne. Duk farashin kusan.
Buga sau 25 sau 800, wato naira 20,000. Refresh shine sau 25 sau 1,500, wanda shine 37,500.
Kudin nata ya ƙunshi ranar shiri da ranar bayarwa: 2 sau 25,000, wanda shine 50,000.
Tare da jujjuyawa da alamomi a 10,000, mai gudanarwa a 15,000, da 5,000 don kiran biyo baya, jimlar jumillar ita ce 137,500.
Ta ƙara da kashi 10 cikin ɗari don sauye-sauyen farashi: 13,750.
Jimlar: Naira 151,250, ko kuma 6,050 ga kowane ɗan takara. Ta faɗi kusan 151,000 kuma ta nuna ainihin abin da kowane adadin ya rufe.
Yarda da rubuta abin da zaku isarwa, kwanakin, sharuɗɗan biyan kuɗi da rahoton. Sannan a aika da rahoton akan lokaci, koda an gauraya sakamakon.

panel.heading: Ci gaba da abokan hulɗa suna dawowa

cards.d: Abubuwan da za a iya bayarwa, kwanan wata, lambobi, sharuɗɗan biyan kuɗi da rahoton, koda a cikin saƙon WhatsApp.
Yi amfani da hanyar canja wuri ko hanyar biyan kuɗi kuma koyaushe bayar da rasidi.
Nuna zaɓuɓɓuka: ƴan mutane ko kayan aiki. Kare aiki da bin diddigi.

say: Lokacin da aka haɗa biyan kuɗi, yi amfani da hanyar canja wuri ko hanyar biyan kuɗi, kuma koyaushe ku ba da rasidi.

say: Don tunawa. Gwada jagoran ku akan wani sabo. Matukin jirgi kafin auna. Farashin komai, gami da shirye-shirye da bibiyar, tare da abin da zai faru. Nuna matsaloli da ingantawa da gaskiya. Kuma shirya kwanaki 90: isarwa, ninka, bibiya, rahoto.

say: Yanzu haɗa kunshin ku, rubuta tsari da kasafin kuɗi, kuma ku kammala kimantawa da shirin ku. Takaddun shaida yana buƙatar ainihin shaidar babban dutse kuma aƙalla kashi 70 cikin ɗari a cikin tambayoyin ƙarshe.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
